design.decision: Bid 8 or more and keep climbing. The multiplier grows with the bid but also deepens any set.
design.opponent: Shown after bidding. A set now costs the bidders heavily, so defence pays.
design.rationale: This is the multiplier counterpart to cb-bid8-trick-points. It rewards high contracts in proportion and carries real set risk. Departure: threshold plus scaling, as above.
design.draftText: +2 contract multiplier for each trick in your team's contract when your team bids 8 or more

critic.concerns: Threshold plus scaling departure; overlaps cb-contract-mult, which scales without the threshold.
